cards.ex: We're setting out early tomorrow morning to avoid the traffic.
cards.exUz: Ertaga ertalab tirbandlikdan qochish uchun erta yo'lga chiqamiz.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat yoki biror maqsad bilan yo'lga tushmoq, safarga otlanmoq.

cards.ex: She has a real sense of adventure, always trying new things.
cards.exUz: Unda haqiqiy sarguzasht hissi bor, doimo yangi narsalarni sinab ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Xavf-xatar va yangilikka intilish, noma'lumga qiziqish tuyg'usi.

cards.ex: The band has been on the road for six months, touring Europe.
cards.exUz: Guruh olti oydan beri Yevropa bo'ylab gastrollarda, yo'lda.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatda bo'lish, ko'chib yurish, doimiy ravishda safarda bo'lish.

cards.ex: They say travel broadens the mind, and I definitely agree after my trip.
cards.exUz: Ular sayohat dunyoqarashni kengaytiradi deyishadi va men sayohatimdan keyin bunga to'liq qo'shilaman.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat insonning bilimini oshiradi, yangi g'oyalar bilan tanishtiradi.

cards.ex: They went off the grid for a week to a cabin in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Ular bir hafta tog'dagi kulbaga borib, aloqasiz yashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Zamonaviy texnologiyalardan uzilgan, internet va aloqadan uzoqda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Pack your bags, we're leaving in an hour!
cards.exUz: Yuklaringizni yig'ing, bir soatdan keyin jo'naymiz!
cards.uzDef: Sayohat uchun kerakli narsalarni sumka yoki chamadonga joylamoq.

cards.ex: She's traveled to the far-flung corners of the earth.
cards.exUz: U yer yuzining olislardagi burchaklariga sayohat qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Dunyodagi uzoq va kam odam boradigan joylar.

cards.ex: He's always had a thirst for adventure, exploring new places.
cards.exUz: U doimo sarguzashtga chanqoq bo'lgan, yangi joylarni o'rganib.
cards.uzDef: Sarguzashtga kuchli istak, yangi va hayajonli narsalarni boshdan kechirishga intilish.

cards.ex: Before you book, explore your options for accommodation.
cards.exUz: Bron qilishdan oldin, turar joy variantlarini o'rganib chiqing.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta variantlar mavjudligini aniqlash va ularni ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: I want to go to Italy to get a taste of Italian culture.
cards.exUz: Men Italiya madaniyatining ta'mini tatib ko'rish uchun Italiyaga bormoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qisqa vaqt ichida boshdan kechirish, ozgina tajriba orttirish.

cards.ex: Don't forget to plan your itinerary before you leave.
cards.exUz: Ketishdan oldin marshrutingizni tuzishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat davomida qilinadigan ishlar va tashrif buyuriladigan joylar rejasini tuzish.

cards.ex: His trip to Asia was a true voyage of discovery.
cards.exUz: Uning Osiyoga sayohati haqiqiy kashfiyot sayohati edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi bilimlar va tajribalar olishga qaratilgan sayohat.

cards.ex: They finally took the plunge and booked a trip around the world.
cards.exUz: Ular nihoyat tavakkal qilib, dunyo bo'ylab sayohatga buyurtma berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilishga qaror qilish, xavfni bo'yniga olib harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We spent the day seeing the sights of Paris.
cards.exUz: Biz kunni Parijning diqqatga sazovor joylarini tomosha qilish bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur va qiziqarli joylarga tashrif buyurish.

cards.ex: They had to hitch a ride to get to the next town.
cards.exUz: Ular keyingi shaharga yetib borish uchun yo'l-yo'lakay mashina to'xtatishga majbur bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bepul mashina so'rab, yo'lda ketayotgan avtomobildan foydalanish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get my bearings in the new city.
cards.exUz: Menga yangi shaharda yo'nalishni aniqlash uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi joyda joylashuvingizni va yo'nalishingizni aniqlash.

cards.ex: This hotel feels like a home away from home.
cards.exUz: Bu mehmonxona uydan uzoqdagi uydek tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatda o'zingizni qulay his qiladigan joy.

cards.ex: The tour guide really went the extra mile to make our trip special.
cards.exUz: Gid sayohatimizni chindan ham ajoyib qilish uchun qo'shimcha harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy talablardan ko'ra ko'proq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: We sat around the campfire, exchanging stories of our travels.
cards.exUz: Biz gulxan atrofida o'tirib, sayohatlarimiz haqidagi hikoyalarimizni almashdik.
cards.uzDef: Tajribalar va voqealarni bir-biringiz bilan bo'lishmoq.

cards.ex: Their car broke down in the middle of nowhere.
cards.exUz: Ularning mashinasi hech qayerda buzilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq, odamsiz va qulayliksiz joyda.

cards.ex: This vacation is a chance to unwind and recharge before going back to work.
cards.exUz: Bu ta'til ishga qaytishdan oldin dam olish va kuch to'plash imkoniyati.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish, stressdan xalos bo'lish va energiya tiklash.

cards.ex: We got a flat tire on the way to the airport and almost missed our flight.
cards.exUz: Aeroportga ketayotganda shinamiz teshilib ketdi va deyarli reysimizga kech qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Mashinaning shinasiga zarar yetkazilishi natijasida havo chiqib ketishi.

cards.ex: We went off course during the hike and got lost in the woods.
cards.exUz: Biz piyoda yurish paytida yo'ldan adashib, o'rmonda adashib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan yo'nalishdan chetga chiqish yoki adashish.

cards.ex: After settling in, we decided to explore the surroundings of the village.
cards.exUz: Joylashib olgach, biz qishloqning atrofini o'rganishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Yangi joyda atrof-muhitni, landshaftni va mahalliy joylarni o'rganish.

cards.ex: This small cafe is a hidden gem, serving the best coffee in town.
cards.exUz: Bu kichik kafe - yashirin gavhar, shahardagi eng yaxshi qahvani taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilikka noma'lum bo'lgan, ammo juda qimmatli va ajoyib joy.

cards.ex: As soon as we arrived, we made a beeline for the beach.
cards.exUz: Biz yetib kelganimiz zahoti, to'g'ri plyajga yo'l oldik.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri va tezda biror joyga yo'nalmoq.

cards.ex: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely breathtaking.
cards.exUz: Tog'ning tepasidan ko'rinish mutlaqo hayratlanarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli va ta'sirli manzara, ko'zni quvontiradigan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: Traveling alone is a great way to face your fears and build confidence.
cards.exUz: Yolg'iz sayohat qilish - qo'rquvlarga qarshi turish va o'ziga ishonchni oshirishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizning qo'rquvlaringiz bilan yuzma-yuz kelish va ularni yengishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Our travel plans went off the rails when the airline cancelled our flight.
cards.exUz: Aviakompaniya reysimizni bekor qilganda, sayohat rejamiz izdan chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Rejadan chetga chiqish, nazoratni yo'qotish, o'zini tuta olmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'll stay in tonight.
cards.exUz: O'zimni biroz kasalmand his qilyapman, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal bo'lish.
